about_the_game:
Collect Mokitons in this city management game, where tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve and bond together in their unique town.

Tamer Town is a unique blend of monster collecting and city-building gameplay. It invites you to build more than just a town — you'll shape an ecosystem where monsters and humans grow, thrive and stand together in competition.

 

Raise over 130 unique Mokitons, each with distinct personalities, elemental traits and evolution paths. Support strong bonds between tamers and their Mokitons — it’s the foundation of a thriving city.

Let Mokitons grow through shared training, work and battles alongside their tamers. Level them up and unlock powerful evolutions through teamwork and care.

 

Push beyond the borders of your city and uncover new biomes, monsters and missions. Complete special objectives to unlock access to unexplored zones.

Send expedition teams on missions like exploration, monster discovery or resource gathering. Prepare carefully — each zone has its own surprises and secrets.

 

Your city's reputation determines who wants to live there — and strong tamers are essential to your success. Keep Mokitons happy and productive to raise your city's prestige.

Build a place where tamers and monsters want to live, train and grow. Rise in the League, go on expeditions and make your city famous across the land.

 

Generate valuable resources, sell goods and invest profits to grow your city. Assign Mokitons to jobs that match their strengths to optimize each building's output. Earn money to unlock new homes, decorations and territories. Shape your city into a thriving hub.

Boost your city's performance by keeping your Mokitons satisfied — they’ll work harder, fight better and power your town’s growth. Build elemental decorations near their homes and craft special treats to meet their needs.

 

Join high-stakes competitions between cities for the Township Tournament Cup. Build your ultimate team and lead them to victory. Assemble a balanced squad of Mokitons that complement each other.

Customize your battle arena to suit your strategy. Climb the ranks, adjust your team to counter rivals, and prove your dominance. You can control the action yourself — or let your city's top tamer take the lead in auto-battles.
 

Stay on your toes — mysterious visitors and events can appear in your city at any time.

Respond to surprise challengers offering unique rewards and rare Mokitons. Adapt to unpredictable strategies and unusual team compositions that will test your flexibility.

Engage in special encounters that push your tactical skills to the limit. Turn every surprise into an opportunity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 z 3,2 GHz lub AMD Ryzen 3 1200 z 3,1 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 with 2 GB VRAM or AMD Radeon R9 270X with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4690K z 3,5 GHz lub AMD Ryzen 5 1500X z 3,5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 with 4 GB VRAM or AMD Radeon R9 290X with 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
